title: Hal Puthoff on Rogan: US holds 15 crashed craft
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hal Puthoff on Rogan: US holds 15 crashed craft, about 2025 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Hal Putoff also went on Joe Rogan a few months ago and said, "We have 15 crash craft in our possession."
like you know if he's saying definitively the 12 to 15 >> crafts you know on on Joe Rogan it's like where are you getting that
tellings.difference: Gives the number as 12 to 15 rather than 15, and the teller doubts where Puthoff got it.
tellings.link_reason: Same story: Puthoff said on Joe Rogan's show that the US holds about 15 crashed craft.

related.note: Both give a count of the crashed craft the US holds. Davis says fewer than 40, which differs from Puthoff's 15, so one count could be right and the other wrong.
